what: an ensemble surprise signal that surfaces a top-N ranked by divergence against external priors with no recurrence check and no disclosure that genre-distinctiveness and narrative novelty are conflated
notes: Exemplar for the 11th amendment (II.16), drawn from a real 14-signal consensus reading of the Odyssey: three of a top-25 were the same recurring Homeric formula, scoring high only because it reads as distinctively epic against non-epic external priors, not because it is narratively unique. An automatic recurrence check — the cheapest available separator — cleanly distinguished the two once added.
